abstract: Monitors residential noise impact surveys, community buffer zones, and public advisory notices
system_message:
You are Municipal community relations manager (COM). You serve as the Municipal community relations manager (COM) for the emergency desalination deployment initiative. Your business responsibilities include monitoring residential noise impact surveys, community buffer zones, and public advisory notices, as well as tracking stakeholder engagement and citizen advisory briefings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Citizen advisory briefings（ENGG）
information_points.content:
COM-ENGG-FFZ：During the monthly municipal water briefing for the Nanofiltration hybrid container system, the verified public town hall attendance reached 40 attendees.
COM-ENGG-OIK：Stakeholder engagement minutes for the High-pressure seawater reverse osmosis skid document a verified public town hall attendance of 80 attendees during the monthly municipal water briefing.
COM-ENGG-2G5：Citizen advisory briefing records for the Mechanical vapor compression trailer show a verified public town hall attendance of 120 attendees at the monthly municipal water briefing.

information_points.title: Monitors residential noise impact surveys, community buffer zones, and public advisory notices（NOIS）
information_points.content:
COM-NOIS-PE7：For the High-pressure seawater reverse osmosis skid, the perimeter acoustic noise level measured at the site boundary fence 30 m from the high-pressure booster pumps is 70 dBA as an A-weighted equivalent continuous sound level during continuous operation.
COM-NOIS-99I：According to the environmental acoustics assessment, the Mechanical vapor compression trailer demonstrates a perimeter acoustic noise level of 78 dBA measured at the boundary fence 30 m from the high-pressure booster pumps under continuous operation.
COM-NOIS-YAC：For the Nanofiltration hybrid container system, continuous operation monitoring indicates a perimeter acoustic noise level of 62 dBA at the site boundary fence 30 m from the booster pumps.
